# ZEDF | w1ll0w's Dashboard

> Personal website, project dashboard, and link hub.

## Projects & Games

- [Arcade Games Hub](https://www.zedf.co.uk/play) - Curated suite of 14 retro browser games, puzzles, and casino classics (Sudoku, Wordle, 2048, Snake, Tetris, Pong, Minesweeper, Asteroids, Speed Typer, Memory, Blackjack, Craps, etc.).
- [Showcase](https://www.zedf.co.uk/showcase) - 3D interactive Wallpaper Engine carousel and dynamic WebGL previews.
- [Wote](https://www.zedf.co.uk/wote) - A minimalist note-taking app with markdown support, syntax highlighting, and themes.
- [Calc67](https://www.zedf.co.uk/calc67) - A daily calculator puzzle game with cloud leaderboards.
- [Personal Space](https://www.zedf.co.uk/project-space) - An immersive interactive nebula of projects and star-charts.
- [3D Setup Showcase](https://www.zedf.co.uk/setup) - Interactive 3D WebGL cyber desk setup and battlestation visualizer.

## University & Personal

- [Uni Dashboard](https://www.zedf.co.uk/uni) - Helpful University of Portsmouth student portal, shortcuts, and academic tools.
- [Uni Campus Map](https://www.zedf.co.uk/uni/map) - Interactive Portsmouth campus navigation map with building locations.
- [Quotes](https://www.zedf.co.uk/quotes) - Personal favourite quotes, philosophy, and film dialogue.

## Links
